- `index.html`: Game UI structure and Three.js module entry.

- Build a playable browser-based 3D mobile/tablet game inspired by Counter-Strike and Half-Life, with two teams competing to 100 points on a small island map.

## Requirements
- Support 10 vs. 10 with 20 distinct operator looks and unique character selection.
- Offer 100 weapons, realistic physics, high graphics, and phone/tablet play.

## Decisions
- Implemented a Three.js island arena with fictional operators and weapons, bot-based matches, responsive UI, and touch controls.

- Built the island arena, lobby and loadout screens, match HUD, pause/end screens, bots, scoring, respawns, weapons, and touch controls.

## Objective
- Build a playable browser-based 3D tactical arena inspired by Counter-Strike and Half-Life, with two teams competing to 100 points on a small island map.

## Requirements
- Support 10 vs. 10 with 20 distinct operator looks and unique character selection.
- Offer 100 weapons, realistic physics, high graphics, and phone/tablet play.

## Decisions
- Implemented a Three.js island arena with fictional operators and weapons, bot-based matches, responsive UI, and touch controls.
- Show touch controls based on touch capability rather than viewport width, including on tablet-sized displays.
- Touch firing captures the fire button’s pointer and fires immediately on touch-down; movement input uses pointer IDs.
